dispositions.title: Deprecate legacy ruby serverlessFunctionTemplates
dispositions.question: Should we archive Ruby serverless templates or update them to Ruby 3.3 runtime?
dispositions.recommendation: Archive to snippets/historical/ and drop active CI validation for Ruby 2.7.
dispositions.reason: Ruby 2.7 and 3.0 runtimes are deprecated on AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Functions.
dispositions.evidence: AWS Lambda deprecation timeline for ruby2.7/3.0; zero repo downloads in 12 months.

dispositions.title: Evaluate adopting OpenTofu for homelab IaC snippets
dispositions.question: Migrate homelab Terraform boilerplates to OpenTofu 1.8+ or maintain dual compatibility?
dispositions.recommendation: Switch templates to OpenTofu by default with terraform alias compatibility.
dispositions.reason: License changes in Terraform 1.6+ diverged from open-source platform goals.
